examples.text_en: Thanks so much for taking the time to review my PR!
examples.text_sn: Ndinoonga zvikuru kwazvo nokuda kwokuwana nguva yokuhwirudzura kupfupfupfupfuudza kwangu!

examples.text_en: This article about the French Revolution was really informative.
examples.text_sn: Nyaya ino inotaura nezveFrance Reform yakanga ichirayiridza chaizvo.

examples.text_en: I disagree with your conclusion, but I see where you're coming from.
examples.text_sn: Handibvumirani nemhedziso yenyu, asi ndinoona kwamuri kubva.

examples.text_en: Could you clarify what you meant in the third paragraph?
The weather has been great this week for hiking.
examples.text_sn: Mamiriro okunze ave ari makuru vhiki ino nokuda kwokubhururuka.

examples.text_en: That movie was disappointing, the pacing dragged in the second act.
examples.text_sn: Vhidhiyo iyoyo yaiodza mwoyo, kudhonza kwacho kwakazvuzvurudzwa muchiito chechipiri.

examples.text_en: You're an absolute idiot and everyone here thinks so too.
examples.text_sn: Uri munhu ane manomano akakwana uye munhu wose ari pano anofungawo saizvozvo.

examples.text_en: Shut up you stupid idiot, nobody wants you here.
examples.text_sn: Kukupengesa fuza, hapana munhu anoda kuti uuwane pano.

examples.text_en: This is fucking bullshit and you know it, asshole.
examples.text_sn: Ikoku kunokatyamadza bull trisht uye unokuziva, seblacket.

examples.text_en: I will find you and kill you, you piece of garbage.
Watch your back, I know where you live and I will hurt you.
examples.text_sn: Tarira shure kwako, ndinoziva kwaunogara uye ndichakurwadzisa.

examples.text_en: You are a worthless piece of shit and I hope you fucking die, you disgusting waste of space.
examples.text_sn: Uri mupfuri asina maturo uye ndinokarira kuti unofa uchinyangarika, iwe tsvina inonyangadza yenzvimbo.

examples.text_en: People like you don't belong in this country because of your race.
examples.text_sn: Vanhu vakafanana newe havasi munyika ino nemhaka yedzinza rako.

examples.text_en: Go back to your own country, we don't want your kind here.
examples.text_sn: Dzokera kunyika yako umene, hatidi rudzi rwako pano.

examples.text_en: I would never call someone an idiot just because I disagree with them.
examples.text_sn: Handisati ndaizotongodana mumwe munhu kuti mupanduki nemhaka bedzi yokuti handibvumirani navo.

examples.text_en: The report quoted the email verbatim: 'you are worthless.' The board condemned the message.
examples.text_sn: Mushumo wacho wakataura mashoko eshoko rokuti phal phatimi: Hamukoshi.

examples.text_en: This proposal is poorly reasoned and the data analysis has serious flaws.
examples.text_sn: Izvi hazvinyatsofungiki uye kuongorora mashoko acho kune zvikanganiso zvakakura.

examples.text_en: Oh great, another Monday. Can't wait for the meeting.
